CheckDataAgentMemoryConfig.description_zh: CheckDataAgentMemoryConfig - 查看DataAgent记忆生成/使用配置

CreateAirflowLoginToken.description_zh: 通过该API可获取Airflow登录凭证，使用此登录凭证可以登录DMS托管Airflow

DeleteAgenticDataSource.description_zh: 删除数据源及其关联元数据目录

DeleteCustomAgent.description_zh:
在个人空间、工作空间中删除自定义Agent

DeleteDataAgentAccuracyTest.description_zh: 删除准确率测试配置项

DeleteDataAgentMcp.description_zh: 删除指定工作空间中的 MCP Server

DescribeCustomAgent.description_zh: DescribeCustomAgent 根据自定义Agent ID获取详情描述信息

DescribeDataAgentTheme.description_en: Invokes the DescribeDataAgentTheme operation to query the details of a specific DataAgent theme, including the theme name, stage, source, common scenarios, description, and creation and modification time
DescribeDataAgentTheme.description_zh: 调用 DescribeDataAgentTheme 接口查询单个 DataAgent 主题的详细信息，包括主题名称、阶段、来源、应用场景、描述和创建修改时间等

DescribeDocument.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specific document

DescribeKnowledgeBaseStats.description_en: Retrieves the statistics of a knowledge base
DescribeKnowledgeBaseStats.description_zh: 获取知识库的统计信息

DescribeKnowledgeBaseUploadSignature.description_en: Generates a signature to upload a document to a knowledge base
DescribeKnowledgeBaseUploadSignature.description_zh: 获取知识库上传文档的签名

DescribeSkillFileUploadSignature.description_zh: DescribeSkillFileUploadSignature 获取技能文件上传签名信息

GetAgenticAgentByInstallToken.description_en: Queries the agent associated with an install token after redemption. Data is empty if the token has not been redeemed
GetAgenticAgentByInstallToken.description_zh: 根据 install token 查询其兑换后关联的 Agent 信息。尚未完成兑换时，Data 为空

GetAgenticCatalog.description_en: Queries the details of an Agentic DMS catalog based on the catalog UUID
GetAgenticCatalog.description_zh: 根据 Catalog UUID 查询 Agentic DMS 的 Catalog 详情

GetAgenticDataSource.description_zh: 按数据源 UUID 查询数据源详情

GetAgenticDatabase.description_en: Queries the details of a database in Agentic DMS based on the database UUID
GetAgenticDatabase.description_zh: 根据 Database UUID 查询 Agentic DMS 的 Database 详情

GetAgenticTableColumn.description_en: Queries the fields of a table based on the database UUID and the fully qualified name of the table
GetAgenticTableColumn.description_zh: 根据 Database UUID 和表的全限定名查询表的字段列表

GetAgenticTableIndex.description_en: Queries the indexes of a table based on the database UUID and the fully qualified name of the table
GetAgenticTableIndex.description_zh: 根据 Database UUID 和表的全限定名查询表的索引列表

GetAirflow.description_en: Queries the configuration and status of an Airflow instance

GetChatContent.description_en: Retrieves chat content from a specific checkpoint by specifying the session ID and AgentId
GetChatContent.description_zh: 通过指定会话ID和AgentId，从特定检查点开始获取聊天内容

GetDataAgentMcp.description_en: Queries the details of an MCP Server by its ID, including the workspace, network, connection method, and running status
GetDataAgentMcp.description_zh: 根据 MCP Server ID 查询其所属工作空间、网络、连接方式和运行状态等信息

GetDataAgentSubAccountInfo.description_en: Retrieves information about a RAM user that belongs to an Alibaba Cloud account
GetDataAgentSubAccountInfo.description_zh: 获取主账号下的子账号信息

GetDataAgentTaskModelUsage.description_en: Queries the model usage summary of DataAgent analysis tasks within a specified time range, including the number of models used, total number of calls, total tokens consumed, and peak TPM
GetDataAgentTaskModelUsage.description_zh: 查询指定时间范围内DataAgent分析任务的模型用量汇总，包括使用的模型数、调用总次数、消耗的Token总量以及峰值TPM

GetDataAgentTaskModelUsageMetrics.description_en: Queries the time-series metrics of tokens per minute (TPM) for DataAgent analysis task model usage within a specified time range, returning token consumption at each time point at a minute-level granularity
GetDataAgentTaskModelUsageMetrics.description_zh: 查询指定时间范围内DataAgent分析任务模型用量的TPM时序指标，按分钟粒度返回各时间点的Token消耗量

GetDataAgentThemeUploadSignature.description_en:
Calls the GetDataAgentThemeUploadSignature operation to obtain OSS direct upload credentials for uploading a DataAgent theme file. After obtaining the credentials, use the PostObject method to upload the theme file directly to OSS. After the upload is complete, call the CreateDataAgentTheme operation with the returned ThemeId to complete theme creation.
For more information, see https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/oss/user-guide/client-direct-transmission/
GetDataAgentThemeUploadSignature.description_zh:
调用 GetDataAgentThemeUploadSignature 接口获取 DataAgent 主题文件上传所需的 OSS 直传凭证。获取凭证后，请通过 PostObject 方式将主题文件直传至 OSS，上传完成后携带返回的 ThemeId 调用 CreateDataAgentTheme 接口完成主题创建。
您可以参考 https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/user-guide/client-direct-transmission/ 文档完成主题上传

GetDataAgentWorkspaceInfo.description_en: Queries the details of a workspace
GetDataAgentWorkspaceInfo.description_zh: 获取协作空间详细信息

GetListMcpServerToolsResult.description_en: Queries the MCP Server connectivity and tool list results by the Session ID returned when the detection was started
GetListMcpServerToolsResult.description_zh: 根据启动检测时返回的 Session ID 查询 MCP Server 连通性和工具列表结果

GetNotebookAndSubmitTask.description_en: Submits a task to schedule and run a Notebook file

GetNotebookTaskStatus.description_en: Retrieves the execution status of a Notebook task

GetWorkspaceCode.description_en: Reads the content of a code file in the workspace and returns the file content along with mtime (in the header)

GetWorkspaceCodePublishSetting.description_zh: 获取工作空间的部署配置

InitWorkspaceSystemMcpServer.description_en: Installs all currently available system MCP services for a specified Data Agent workspace
InitWorkspaceSystemMcpServer.description_zh: 为指定 Data Agent 工作空间安装全部当前可用的系统 MCP 服务

ListAgenticCatalog.description_en: Performs a paging query on the catalogs in Agentic DMS. You can filter the results by catalog type and name prefix
ListAgenticCatalog.description_zh: 分页查询 Agentic DMS 的 Catalog 列表，可按 Catalog 类型和名称前缀筛选

ListAgenticDataSources.description_en: Performs a paged query on the data sources of the current account by using paging
ListAgenticDataSources.description_zh: 分页查询当前账号下的数据源

ListAgenticDatabase.description_en: Performs a paged query for the list of databases in a specified catalog, with options to filter by name prefix and specify the sorting method for paging
ListAgenticDatabase.description_zh: 分页查询指定 Catalog 下的 Database 列表，可按名称前缀筛选并指定排序方式

ListAgenticGlobalSqlExecutionHistories.description_en: Queries the SQL execution history within the current tenant and returns the results in descending order of execution start time. Only AGENT_QUERY and WORKFLOW_QUERY are included
ListAgenticGlobalSqlExecutionHistories.description_zh: 查询当前租户内的 SQL 执行历史，按执行开始时间倒序返回。只包含 AGENT_QUERY 和 WORKFLOW_QUERY

ListAgenticSqlExecutionHistories.description_en: Queries the SQL execution history visible to the current caller, sorted in descending order by execution start time. Only AGENT_QUERY and WORKFLOW_QUERY are included
ListAgenticSqlExecutionHistories.description_zh: 查询当前调用者可见的 SQL 执行历史，按执行开始时间倒序返回。只包含 AGENT_QUERY 和 WORKFLOW_QUERY

ListAgenticTableBaseInfo.description_en: Queries the basic information and engine metadata of tables in a specified database by using paging. You can filter the results by keyword and table type, and specify the sorting method
ListAgenticTableBaseInfo.description_zh: 分页查询指定 Database 下表的基础信息和引擎元数据，可按关键字和表类型筛选，并指定排序方式

ListAirflows.description_en: Retrieves a list of Airflow instances in a workspace
ListAirflows.description_zh: 获取工作空间的Airflow实例列表

ListCustomAgent.description_en: Lists all custom agents in personal and team workspaces
ListCustomAgent.description_zh: ListCustomAgent 获取个人空间、工作空间中所有自定义Agent列表

ListCustomAgentMonitorSessions.description_en: ListCustomAgentMonitorSessions - Retrieves the list of monitoring sessions for custom agents
ListCustomAgentMonitorSessions.description_zh: ListCustomAgentMonitorSessions - 获取自定义Agent监控会话列表数据

ListDataAgentAccuracyTestInstances.description_en: Lists the accuracy test configuration items that meet the specified conditions
ListDataAgentAccuracyTestInstances.description_zh: 列出满足条件的准确率测试配置项

ListDataAgentAccuracyTestResults.description_en: Retrieves the execution results of a self-test task
ListDataAgentAccuracyTestResults.description_zh: 获取自测任务的执行结果

ListDataAgentAccuracyTestTasks.description_en: Queries the running status of accuracy test nodes by using paging
ListDataAgentAccuracyTestTasks.description_zh: 分页查询自测任务运行状态

ListDataAgentMcp.description_en: Queries MCP Servers in a specified workspace by paging. You can filter results by name, ready status, and service type
ListDataAgentMcp.description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的 MCP Server，可按名称、就绪状态和服务类型筛选

ListDataAgentMemory.description_zh: ListDataAgentMemory 获取DataAgent记忆列表（子账号粒度最多50条记忆）

ListDataAgentSession.description_en: Retrieves the list of historical session descriptions for Data Agent
ListDataAgentSession.description_zh: 获取Data Agent历史会话描述列表

ListDataAgentSkillMeta.description_en: Retrieves the list of DataAgent skills

ListDataAgentTheme.description_en: Calls the ListDataAgentTheme operation to query the DataAgent theme list by paging. You can filter results by theme stage, source, and common scenario
ListDataAgentTheme.description_zh: 调用 ListDataAgentTheme 接口分页查询 DataAgent 主题列表，支持按主题阶段、来源和应用场景过滤

ListDataAgentWorkspace.description_en: Queries a paginated list of collaborative workspaces under the Alibaba Cloud account
ListDataAgentWorkspace.description_zh: 获取主账号下的协作空间（分页）

ListDataAgentWorkspaceMember.description_en: Lists all members in a workspace

ListDataCenterDatabase.description_en: Retrieves the list of files uploaded by users in the data center. Only file types are supported. Database types are not supported
ListDataCenterDatabase.description_zh: 获取数据中心用户上传的文件列表，仅支持文件类型，不支持数据库类型

ListDataCenterTable.description_en: Retrieves a list of user-uploaded tables from the data center, for file types only
ListDataCenterTable.description_zh: 获取数据中心用户上传的表列表，仅支持文件类型，不支持数据库类型

ListDocuments.description_en: Lists the documents in a knowledge base
ListDocuments.description_zh: 查询知识库中的文档列表

ListKnowledgeBases.description_en: Returns a paginated list of knowledge bases
ListKnowledgeBases.description_zh: 分页查询知识库的列表

ListOneMetaOssieModels.description_en: Retrieves a list of OSSIE models

ListWorkspaceCode.description_en: Lists code files and directories at a specified path in a workspace
ListWorkspaceCode.description_zh: 列出工作空间目录下的code文件

ModifyCustomAgent.description_en: Modifies a custom agent in a personal or team workspace
ModifyCustomAgent.description_zh: 在个人空间、工作空间中修改自定义Agent

ModifyDataAgentMcp.description_en: Modifies the configuration of an MCP server

ModifyDataAgentTheme.description_en: Modifies the display name and description of a DataAgent theme. A null parameter value indicates that the corresponding field is not modified, and an empty string clears the field
ModifyDataAgentTheme.description_zh: 调用 ModifyDataAgentTheme 接口修改 DataAgent 主题的用户展示名和描述。参数值传 null 表示不修改对应字段，传空字符串表示清空

OperateCustomAgent.description_en: Operate custom agents in personal spaces and workspaces
OperateCustomAgent.description_zh: 在个人空间、工作空间中操作自定义Agent

RemoveUserToDataAgentWorkspace.description_en: Removes a user from a workspace

ResetAgenticApiKey.description_en: Resets the Access Token of a specified data gateway. The associated Agent and name are retained, and only the plaintext Access Token is regenerated. The old Access Token becomes invalid immediately. The new plaintext Access Token is returned only once in this response. Store it securely right away. Only the creator of the Access Token can reset it, and only Access Tokens issued by the console (source=console) can be reset
ResetAgenticApiKey.description_zh: 重置指定数据网关 Access Token：保留归属 Agent 与名称，仅重新生成明文 Access Token，旧 Access Token 立即失效；新明文 Access Token 仅在本次响应中一次性返回，请立即妥善保存。仅该 Access Token 的创建者本人可重置，且仅支持重置由控制台签发（source=console）的 Access Token

SaveWorkspaceCode.description_en: Saves workspace code. If the file does not exist, a new file is automatically created
SaveWorkspaceCode.description_zh: 保存工作空间代码，如果文件不存在则自动新建

SearchAgenticCatalog.description_en: Searches for catalogs in Agentic DMS by keyword, catalog type, database type, or a list of catalog UUIDs, and returns paginated results
SearchAgenticCatalog.description_zh: 按关键字、Catalog 类型、数据库类型或 Catalog UUID 列表搜索 Agentic DMS 的 Catalog，结果分页返回

SearchAgenticDatabase.description_en: Searches for databases across catalogs by keyword. You can filter the results by catalog, database type, and environment type. The results are paginated
SearchAgenticDatabase.description_zh: 跨 Catalog 按关键字搜索 Database，可按所属 Catalog、数据库类型和环境类型筛选，结果分页返回

SendChatMessage.description_en: Sends a user message to a specified session or cancels a session
SendChatMessage.description_zh: 向指定会话发送用户消息或取消会话

SetWorkspaceCodePublishSetting.description_en: Sets the code deployment configuration for a workspace. This is an asynchronous operation that returns a key. Use this key to query the operation's status by calling the WorkspaceActionStatus operation
SetWorkspaceCodePublishSetting.description_zh: 设置工作空间代码部署配置。这是个异步接口，请求返回一个key，请根据key查询 WorkspaceActionStatus接口获取状态

SetWorkspaceQuota.description_en: Sets the quota for a workspace

StartListMcpServerTools.description_en: Asynchronously starts MCP Server connectivity and tool list detection. The first call prompts you to wait one minute for resource provisioning. Subsequent calls return a temporary Session ID for polling the result
StartListMcpServerTools.description_zh: 异步启动 MCP Server 连通性和工具列表检测，首次调用会提示需要等待一分钟拉起资源，后再次调用将返回用于轮询结果的临时 Session ID

TestAgenticDataSourceConnection.description_en: Tests whether the network and authentication information of a data source are available
TestAgenticDataSourceConnection.description_zh: 测试数据源的网络和认证信息是否可用

UpdateAgenticDataSource.description_en: Updates the connection, authentication, or display information of an existing data source
UpdateAgenticDataSource.description_zh: 更新已有数据源的连接、认证或展示信息

UpdateAirflow.description_en: Updates the information of an Airflow instance

UpdateDataAgentAccuracyTest.description_en: Updates the content of an accuracy test item
UpdateDataAgentAccuracyTest.description_zh: 更新准确率测试项内容

UploadDocument.description_en: Uploads a document to a knowledge base

UpsertDocumentChunks.description_en: Upserts document chunks into a knowledge base

WorkspaceActionLog.description_zh: 工作空间异步操作日志查询接口

WorkspaceActionStatus.description_en: Queries the status of an asynchronous task in a workspace. Operations such as a deployment return a key. Call this operation with the key to retrieve the task's status
WorkspaceActionStatus.description_zh: 工作空间异步操作状态查询接口，比如部署代码接口返回一个key，根据这个key来查这个status接口，即可获取到状态

WorkspaceCodePublish.description_en: This asynchronous API returns a key. Use this key to query the WorkspaceActionStatus API for the code deployment status
WorkspaceCodePublish.description_zh: 工作空间代码部署接口。这是个异步接口，请求返回一个key，请根据key查询 WorkspaceActionStatus接口获取状态
